QC.no_cloning.statement: There is no unitary U on H⊗H with U(|ψ⟩⊗|0⟩)=|ψ⟩⊗|ψ⟩ for all states |ψ⟩ (no-cloning).

QC.pauli_anticommute.statement: The Pauli matrices X,Y,Z pairwise anticommute and each squares to I.

QC.pauli_basis.statement: {I,X,Y,Z} is a basis of the ℂ-vector space of 2×2 complex matrices.

QC.hadamard_involutive.statement: The Hadamard matrix H satisfies H†=H and H²=I.

QC.hadamard_XZ.statement: H = (X+Z)/√2, and H X H = Z.

QC.bell_orthonormal.statement: The four Bell states form an orthonormal basis of ℂ²⊗ℂ².

QC.chsh_tsirelson.statement: The quantum CHSH operator has operator norm ≤ 2√2 (Tsirelson's bound).

QC.teleportation_identity.statement: The teleportation protocol's post-correction state equals the input state.

QC.deutsch_correct.statement: Deutsch's algorithm decides constant-vs-balanced of f:{0,1}→{0,1} with one oracle query.

QC.density_matrix_unitary_invariant.statement: If ρ⪰0 and Tr ρ=1 then UρU† ⪰0 and Tr(UρU†)=1 for unitary U.

QC.pure_state_zero_entropy.statement: The von Neumann entropy S(ρ)= -Tr(ρ log ρ) of a pure state is 0.

QC.qft_unitary.statement: The n-qubit quantum Fourier transform matrix is unitary.

QC.superdense_two_bits.statement: Superdense coding transmits 2 classical bits via 1 qubit + prior entanglement (encoding is injective on the 4 messages).

QC.toffoli_unitary.statement: The Toffoli (CCNOT) matrix is a permutation matrix hence unitary and its own inverse.

QC.robertson_uncertainty.statement: For observables A,B and state ψ: ΔA·ΔB ≥ ½|⟨[A,B]⟩| (Robertson relation).

QC.ghz3_normalized.statement: The 3-qubit GHZ state (|0…0⟩+|1…1⟩)/√2 is a unit vector.

QC.bloch_sphere_bijection.statement: Pure qubit states modulo global phase biject with points of the 2-sphere S².

QC.kraus_trace_preserving.statement: A CPTP map Σ_k E_k ρ E_k† with Σ_k E_k†E_k = I preserves trace.

QC.ghz_nonlocal.statement: The 3-qubit GHZ state yields a deterministic Mermin paradox contradiction with local hidden variables.

QC.swap_test_overlap.statement: The SWAP test accepts two states with probability (1+|⟨ψ|φ⟩|²)/2.

QC.ghz2_normalized.statement: The 2-qubit GHZ state (|0…0⟩+|1…1⟩)/√2 is a unit vector.

QC.ghz4_normalized.statement: The 4-qubit GHZ state (|0…0⟩+|1…1⟩)/√2 is a unit vector.

QC.ghz5_normalized.statement: The 5-qubit GHZ state (|0…0⟩+|1…1⟩)/√2 is a unit vector.

QC.ghz6_normalized.statement: The 6-qubit GHZ state (|0…0⟩+|1…1⟩)/√2 is a unit vector.

QC.ghz7_normalized.statement: The 7-qubit GHZ state (|0…0⟩+|1…1⟩)/√2 is a unit vector.

QC.ghz8_normalized.statement: The 8-qubit GHZ state (|0…0⟩+|1…1⟩)/√2 is a unit vector.

CS.insertion_sort_correct.statement: insertionSort returns a sorted permutation of its input.

CS.mergesort_correct.statement: mergeSort returns a sorted permutation of its input.

CS.halting_undecidable.statement: There is no total computable H deciding whether program p halts on input x (diagonalization).

CS.pumping_regular.statement: Every regular language satisfies the pumping lemma.

CS.euclid_gcd_correct.statement: Euclid's algorithm returns gcd(a,b) and terminates.

CS.binary_search_correct.statement: Binary search on a sorted array returns an index iff the key is present.

CS.pigeonhole_hash.statement: Any hash from an (n+1)-set to an n-set has a collision.

CS.kleene_regex_dfa.statement: A language is regular iff it is accepted by a DFA (Kleene, finite direction).

CS.knaster_tarski.statement: A monotone map on a complete lattice has a least fixed point.

CS.cantor_powerset.statement: There is no surjection A → 𝒫(A) (Cantor).

CS.huffman_optimal.statement: Huffman coding minimizes expected codeword length among prefix codes.

CS.master_theorem_case1.statement: T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n) with f(n)=O(n^{log_b a − ε}) gives T(n)=Θ(n^{log_b a}).

CS.ackermann_total.statement: The Ackermann function is total (well-founded on lexicographic ℕ²).

CS.dfa_complement_regular.statement: Regular languages are closed under complement.

CS.dijkstra_correct.statement: Dijkstra's algorithm computes shortest-path distances on nonnegative-weight graphs.

CS.church_rosser_beta_diamond.statement: One-step parallel β-reduction in the λ-calculus has the diamond property.

CS.pcp_pigeon_bound.statement: Any prefix-free binary code satisfies Kraft's inequality Σ 2^{-ℓ_i} ≤ 1.

CS.rice_nontrivial.statement: Every nontrivial semantic property of programs is undecidable (Rice).

Math.sum_two_squares.statement: A prime p is a sum of two squares iff p=2 or p≡1 (mod 4).

Math.lagrange_four_squares.statement: Every natural number is a sum of four squares.

Math.bertrand_postulate.statement: For every n≥1 there is a prime p with n<p≤2n.

Math.cauchy_group.statement: If a prime p divides |G| then G has an element of order p (Cauchy).

Math.lagrange_subgroup.statement: The order of a subgroup divides the order of a finite group.

Math.fta_algebra.statement: Every nonconstant complex polynomial has a root (fundamental theorem of algebra).

Math.ivt.statement: A continuous function on [a,b] attains every value between f(a) and f(b).

Math.bolzano_weierstrass.statement: Every bounded sequence in ℝ^n has a convergent subsequence.

Math.heine_borel.statement: A subset of ℝ^n is compact iff it is closed and bounded.

Math.mean_value.statement: A differentiable f on [a,b] has c with f'(c)=(f(b)−f(a))/(b−a).

Math.weierstrass_approx.statement: Polynomials are dense in C([a,b]) under the sup norm.

Math.halls_marriage.statement: A bipartite graph has a perfect matching iff Hall's condition holds.

Math.catalan_closed.statement: The nth Catalan number equals C(2n,n)/(n+1).

Frontier.Tarski_undefinability.statement: Arithmetical truth is not arithmetically definable (Tarski).

Frontier.Aronszajn_tree_exists.statement: There exists an Aronszajn tree (a tree of height ω₁ with no uncountable branch/level).

Frontier.infinite_ramsey.statement: Every 2-colouring of [ℕ]² has an infinite monochromatic set (infinite Ramsey).

Frontier.Loeb_theorem.statement: Löb's theorem: if PA ⊢ (□φ → φ) then PA ⊢ φ.

Frontier.Brun_twin_reciprocal.statement: The sum of reciprocals of twin primes converges (Brun's constant).

Frontier.RH_Li_criterion.statement: RH ⇔ Li's coefficients λ_n ≥ 0 for all n≥1 (state and prove the equivalence).

Frontier.P_vs_NP_statement.statement: State P ≠ NP via time-bounded Turing machines and polynomial reducibility.

Frontier.jones_polynomial_invariant.statement: The Jones polynomial is a link invariant (well-defined under Reidemeister moves).

Math.euler_pentagonal.statement: Euler's pentagonal number theorem for the partition generating function.

Math.brouwer_2d.statement: Every continuous self-map of the closed 2-disk has a fixed point.

Math.baire_category.statement: A complete metric space is not a countable union of nowhere-dense sets.

Math.dilworth.statement: In a finite poset, the minimum antichain cover equals the longest chain length.

Math.sperner_lemma.statement: Every Sperner coloring of a triangulated simplex has an odd number of rainbow cells.

Math.fermat_little.statement: For prime p and a not divisible by p, a^{p−1} ≡ 1 (mod p).

Math.abel_ruffini_deg5.statement: The general quintic is not solvable by radicals (Galois-theoretic).

Math.gauss_bonnet_polygon.statement: The angle sum of a geodesic triangle on the unit sphere exceeds π by its area.

Math.two_squares_5.statement: The prime 5 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_13.statement: The prime 13 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_17.statement: The prime 17 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_29.statement: The prime 29 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_37.statement: The prime 37 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_41.statement: The prime 41 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_53.statement: The prime 53 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_61.statement: The prime 61 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_73.statement: The prime 73 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_89.statement: The prime 89 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_97.statement: The prime 97 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_101.statement: The prime 101 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_109.statement: The prime 109 is a sum of two squares.

Math.two_squares_113.statement: The prime 113 is a sum of two squares.

CS.sorting_lb_3.statement: Any comparison sort of 3 elements needs ≥ ⌈log₂(3!)⌉ comparisons in the worst case.

CS.sorting_lb_4.statement: Any comparison sort of 4 elements needs ≥ ⌈log₂(4!)⌉ comparisons in the worst case.

CS.sorting_lb_5.statement: Any comparison sort of 5 elements needs ≥ ⌈log₂(5!)⌉ comparisons in the worst case.

QPhys.canonical_commutator.statement: On Schwartz space, [x,p]=iℏ with p=-iℏ d/dx.

QPhys.hermitian_real_spectrum.statement: Every eigenvalue of a Hermitian operator is real.

QPhys.unitary_time_evolution.statement: For self-adjoint H, U(t)=exp(-iHt/ℏ) is unitary for all real t.

QPhys.oscillator_spectrum.statement: The quantum harmonic oscillator has spectrum {ℏω(n+½) : n∈ℕ} via ladder operators.

QPhys.particle_in_box.statement: The infinite square well of width L has energies E_n = n²π²ℏ²/(2mL²), n≥1.

QPhys.heisenberg_uncertainty.statement: Δx·Δp ≥ ℏ/2 for any normalized state (from the canonical commutator + Cauchy–Schwarz).

QPhys.stone_generator.statement: A strongly continuous one-parameter unitary group has a self-adjoint generator (Stone).

QPhys.spectral_theorem_finite.statement: Every Hermitian matrix is unitarily diagonalizable with real eigenvalues.

QPhys.bcH_special.statement: For [A,B] central, e^A e^B = e^{A+B+½[A,B]} (BCH special case).

QPhys.variational_bound.statement: For Hamiltonian H, ⟨ψ|H|ψ⟩/⟨ψ|ψ⟩ ≥ E_0 (ground-state variational bound).

QPhys.commuting_simultaneous.statement: Two commuting Hermitian operators are simultaneously diagonalizable.

Chem.huckel_cycle_spectrum.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_n are 2cos(2πk/n), k=0..n-1 (Hückel π-energies).

QPhys.parseval_fourier.statement: The Fourier transform is an L² isometry (Plancherel/Parseval).

QPhys.noether_translation.statement: Translation invariance of the Lagrangian implies conservation of momentum (1D).

QPhys.pauli_exclusion_antisym.statement: A two-fermion antisymmetric state with equal single-particle states is zero.

Chem.euler_polyhedron.statement: For a convex polyhedron (e.g. fullerene cage) V−E+F=2 (Euler's formula).

Chem.polya_isomer_count.statement: Counting substitution isomers on a symmetric skeleton equals the Burnside/Pólya cycle-index average.

Chem.point_group_finite_O3.statement: Every molecular point group is a finite subgroup of O(3).

Chem.benzene_D6h_irreps.statement: The character table of D₆ₕ has the correct number of irreducible representations (=conjugacy classes).

Chem.wiener_path_formula.statement: The Wiener index of the path graph P_n equals C(n+1,3).

Chem.handshake_valence.statement: Sum of atomic valences (vertex degrees) equals twice the number of bonds.

Chem.entropy_concave.statement: The Gibbs entropy −Σ p_i log p_i is concave in the probability vector.

Chem.arrhenius_monotone.statement: The Arrhenius rate k=A e^{−Ea/RT} is strictly increasing in T for Ea>0.

Chem.huckel_C3.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_3 are 2·cos(2πk/3) for k=0..2.

Chem.huckel_C4.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_4 are 2·cos(2πk/4) for k=0..3.

Chem.huckel_C5.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_5 are 2·cos(2πk/5) for k=0..4.

Chem.huckel_C6.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_6 are 2·cos(2πk/6) for k=0..5.

Chem.huckel_C7.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_7 are 2·cos(2πk/7) for k=0..6.

Chem.huckel_C8.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_8 are 2·cos(2πk/8) for k=0..7.

Chem.huckel_C9.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_9 are 2·cos(2πk/9) for k=0..8.

Chem.huckel_C10.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_10 are 2·cos(2πk/10) for k=0..9.

Chem.huckel_C11.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_11 are 2·cos(2πk/11) for k=0..10.

Chem.huckel_C12.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_12 are 2·cos(2πk/12) for k=0..11.

Chem.huckel_C13.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_13 are 2·cos(2πk/13) for k=0..12.

Chem.huckel_C14.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_14 are 2·cos(2πk/14) for k=0..13.

Chem.fullerene_pentagons.statement: A trivalent polyhedron with only pentagon/hexagon faces has exactly 12 pentagons.

Chem.balance_nullspace.statement: A chemical reaction balances iff the stoichiometric matrix has a positive integer null vector.

Chem.gibbs_phase_rule.statement: Degrees of freedom F = C − P + 2 as an affine-dimension count.

Chem.alkane_tree.statement: The carbon skeleton of an acyclic alkane C_nH_{2n+2} is a tree with n−1 C–C bonds.

Chem.leChatelier_sign.statement: For an exothermic reaction, the equilibrium constant K(T) is strictly decreasing in T (van 't Hoff).

Chem.molecular_orbital_count.statement: LCAO of n atomic orbitals yields exactly n molecular orbitals (dimension preservation).

Chem.huckel_C15.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_15 are 2·cos(2πk/15) for k=0..14.

Chem.huckel_C16.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_16 are 2·cos(2πk/16) for k=0..15.

Chem.huckel_C17.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_17 are 2·cos(2πk/17) for k=0..16.

Chem.huckel_C18.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_18 are 2·cos(2πk/18) for k=0..17.

Chem.huckel_C19.statement: The adjacency eigenvalues of the cycle graph C_19 are 2·cos(2πk/19) for k=0..18.
